## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a compact offline-first data module with Android fundamentals (Retrofit/Room/Compose) and to articulate data flow, background work, and UX signals.

- Room entity/DAO and migrations
- Retrofit/JSON parsing
- Jetpack Compose lazy list with search

- Offline-first UX and conflict-free sync basics

## Code Example

```kotlin
@Entity(tableName = "exercises")
data class Exercise(
  @PrimaryKey val id: String,
  val name: String,
  val muscleGroup: String,
  val equipment: String,
  val isFavorite: Boolean = false
)

@Dao
interface ExerciseDao {
  @Query("SELECT * FROM exercises WHERE name LIKE :q || '%' ORDER BY name")
  fun search(q: String): List<Exercise>

  @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
  suspend fun upsert(exercise: Exercise)

  @Query("SELECT * FROM exercises")
  suspend fun getAll(): List<Exercise>
}
```

## Why This Is Asked

Tests MVVM fundamentals, repository pattern, local caching with Room, and basic network handling with Retrofit. Also checks startup data flow, UI state management, and testability.

## Key Concepts

- MVVM with ViewModel and LiveData/Flow
- Room as local cache and source of truth
- Repository coordinating local and remote data
- Retrofit for REST calls
- UI states: loading, empty, error
- Basic unit/UI tests for repository/DAO

## Code Example

```javascript
// Kotlin-like pseudocode for quick reference
data class Note(val id: String, val text: String)
interface NoteDao { @Query("SELECT * FROM notes") fun getAll(): List<Note> @Insert fun insertAll(notes: List<Note>) }
interface NotesApi { @GET("/notes") suspend fun getNotes(): List<Note> }
class NotesRepository(val dao: NoteDao, val api: NotesApi) {
  suspend fun getNotes(): List<Note> {
    val local = dao.getAll()
    if (local.isNotEmpty()) return local
    val fresh = api.getNotes()
    dao.insertAll(fresh)
    return fresh
  }
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you test retry logic and network failures?
- How would you handle data migrations if the schema changes?

## Code Example
```kotlin
// Kotlin sketch: encrypt deltas with Android Keystore
fun encryptDeltas(deltas: ByteArray, keyAlias: String): ByteArray {
  val ks = KeyStore.getInstance("AndroidKeyStore").apply { load(null) }
  val cert = ks.getCertificate(keyAlias) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("No key")
  val public = cert.publicKey
  val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("RSA/ECB/PKCS1Padding")
  cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, public)
  return cipher.doFinal(deltas)
}
```

data class Post(val userId: Int, val id: Int, val title: String, val body: String)
interface PostsApi { suspend fun getPosts(): List<Post> }
class PostsRepository(private val api: PostsApi) {
  private var cache: List<Post>? = null
  suspend fun getPosts(): List<Post> {
    cache?.let { return it }
    val data = api.getPosts()
    cache = data
    return data
  }
}
